9832/16.caution: the differing operand is the DESTINATION slot, so this is either register allocation or a bit the field map assigns to that slot which is not part of it. ANSWERED FOR op9832 BY THE COMPILER, not by a patch: asked for the same select with the result in another register, Apple emits operand 0 values 4 and 6 for fmax and 36 and 38 for fmin, so the low bits follow the allocator and bit 5 does not - the field map over-assigns bit 5 to this slot (tools/g17selcarrier.py, isa/g17-select-carrier.json). What a compiler cannot answer is which of the two perfectly-correlated bits the hardware READS, and patching the compiled archive cannot either: the loader recompiles from its embedded AIR and every such patch is inert - a control that changed the decoded opcode from 9832 to 9932 left the output byte-identical
